d: We are seeking a commercially driven and highly connected Sales & Vendor Partnerships Lead to identify, source, attract and secure high-quality vendors and business partners for our premium retail, dining and entertainment offerings.

The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and developing relationships with established Saudi businesses, emerging entrepreneurs, independent brands, artisans and speciality retailers.
A key objective of this position is to champion Saudi entrepreneurship, showcase local craftsmanship and provide a platform for homegrown brands to reach a premium audience.

The role requires a strong combination of business development, market research, sales, vendor procurement and commercial negotiation skills. The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire vendor acquisition process, from identifying potential businesses and assessing their suitability to negotiating commercial agreements and coordinating onboarding.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality or a related field preferred.
4–6 years of experience in sales, business development, commercial leasing, retail partnerships or vendor acquisition.
Proven experience sourcing and securing business partnerships, vendors or commercial tenants.
Strong knowledge of the Saudi retail, lifestyle, F&B and entrepreneurial landscape.
An established network of contacts within the Saudi business community would be highly advantageous.
Experience working with premium, luxury or lifestyle brands is preferred.
Strong commercial negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
Excellent research, analytical and organisational capabilities.
Ability to independently manage a sales pipeline and deliver against commercial targets.
Fluent English; Arabic is highly preferred.
SIHAMCO is a strategic partner operating proudly under the General Entertainment Authority (GEA), National Events Center (NEC), Riyadh Season and Jeddah Season since 2019.

At SIHAMCO, we don’t just lead Saudi Arabia’s hospitality and entertainment evolution—we create it from the ground up. Since 2008, we’ve been designing, constructing, and operating exceptional experiences that blend local authenticity with global standards. Every destination and concept we launch reflects our commitment to cultural storytelling, creative excellence, and operational precision.

All brands under SIHAMCO are homegrown Saudi concepts, fully developed in-house — from initial vision and brand identity to concept creation, design, execution and operation. We don’t import ideas; we build them — crafting unforgettable experiences from scratch that resonate deeply with both local and international audiences.

Every brand under our umbrella is proudly reflecting the heart and soul of Saudi culture, while achieving international acclaim. With over 25 original homegrown brands, SIHAMCO not only sets — but consistently surpasses — global standards in Entertainment, Hospitality, F&B, Lifestyle, Wellness, Family & Pet Entertainment Experience. Our signature ventures: The Groves, ZodiaC Cuisine, Little Krazy, LucaLand, LucaPark, The Polar Ice Bar, Milk & Butter Nail Spa, Kooz Karak, Birds of Eden, El Lechazo, Khawaja Yanni, Zama Zulu, Hawanim Groves City, Vida Vera, The Groves Pizzeria and Gem-In-I showcase what it means to innovate locally and shine globally.
Our brands are also registered across the GCC and internationally such as the United Kingdom, Egypt, Morocco etc ensuring full legal protection and readiness for global expansion.

Several exciting new concepts and brands are currently under development, with launches planned in the coming months. From bold new ideas to thoughtfully crafted experiences, SIHAMCO continues to grow its portfolio with originality, creativity and cultural pride.
Our team is our greatest asset—a dynamic mix of local talent and international expertise, all united by a passion for excellence. We nurture careers, encourage creativity, and build leaders.
r: Conduct comprehensive market research to identify premium Saudi-owned businesses, independent brands, entrepreneurs, artisans and speciality vendors.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential vendors across retail, fashion, accessories, beauty, lifestyle, gifting, speciality food, F&B and experiential concepts.
Identify emerging Saudi brands, unique products and innovative business concepts that align with premium customer experiences.
Research local markets, exhibitions, trade shows, business networks, social media and entrepreneurial communities to discover potential partners.
Identify market opportunities and recommend concepts that enhance the overall customer experience.
Proactively approach, pitch and secure suitable vendors and commercial partners.
Present business opportunities, commercial propositions and partnership benefits to prospective businesses.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with Saudi entrepreneurs, business owners, established brands and potential commercial partners.
Lead commercial discussions, negotiate rental agreements and secure vendor commitments.
Manage the sales pipeline from initial contact through to agreement execution.
Achieve agreed vendor acquisition targets and commercial deadlines.
Evaluate prospective vendors based on brand positioning, product quality, uniqueness, customer appeal and commercial viability.
Assess each business's operational capabilities, financial stability, reputation and readiness to operate within a premium environment.
Ensure proposed vendors align with required quality standards, brand positioning and customer expectations.
Present shortlisted vendors and recommendations to management for approval.
Maintain a balanced and complementary vendor portfolio, avoiding unnecessary duplication of products or concepts.
Develop an understanding of rental structures, commercial terms and vendor partnership models.
Negotiate rental rates, contract terms and other commercial arrangements within approved guidelines.
Monitor sales conversion, occupancy and vendor acquisition performance.
Maintain accurate records of prospects, negotiations, agreements and vendor information.
Provide regular sales pipeline reports, market insights and commercial updates to management.
Coordinate with operations, marketing, design and management teams to facilitate vendor onboarding.
Ensure vendors understand operational requirements, brand standards and commercial expectations.
Work closely with vendors to ensure their products, presentation and customer experience meet required standards.
Maintain ongoing relationships with vendors, identifying opportunities for future collaborations and business development.
Act as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned vendor partnerships.
